purpose: Consolidate the next evidence-backed mechanics frontier after restored-skill identity/acquisition recovery.
policy: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative. Research batches and audit artifacts are evidence layers. Source-reported numbers remain bounded by their source/version; unresolved frames, scaling, reward probabilities, and hidden gates remain null/unresolved.

records.name: Assault Rain
records.mechanics_boundary: Tracked aerial Ki-blast barrage; current evidence supports 10 hits, long range, launching behavior, and source-reported ~15% total damage.

records.name: Super Electric Strike
records.mechanics_boundary: Large tracked Ki wave; current evidence supports 17 hits, long range, knockback, and source-reported ~40% total damage.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.mechanics_boundary: Short-range omnidirectional explosion; holding extends/repeats the explosion by consuming additional Ki, with current evidence allowing extension up to four Ki bars total. Official update history documents the historical 200→100 Ki change.

records.name: Heavenly Arrow
records.mechanics_boundary: Backward-moving 8-hit Ki barrage; forward input adds an unblockable Ki-powered hand strike and extra Ki bullet. Long-range/knockback behavior is documented.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.mechanics_boundary: Frontal Ki counter barrier; current dedicated evidence supports a 6-hit counter projectile, knockback, and 20% source-reported damage when triggered by a Ki Blast skill. Exact counter window, complete coverage, frame data, and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.
unresolved: exact coverage of countered Ki attacks

records.name: Shooting Strike
records.mechanics_boundary: Ranged Gamma 1 ray-gun projectile followed on connection by a flying-kick follow-up; current repository evidence maintains the PQ156 endpoint and source-reported 10% damage.

records.name: Apocalyptic Burst
records.mechanics_boundary: Ranged multi-stage Ki Blast Ultimate; current repository evidence confirms the staged burst behavior but does not establish a safe universal hit count, frame profile, scaling formula, or reward probability.

records.name: Time Skip/Jump Spike
records.mechanics_boundary: Forward rush that strikes the target; holding input extends flight range. Current evidence also records Strike immunity during the rush and Hit-training provenance, while preserving the historical lesson-description naming issue.

records.name: Gigantic Rage
records.mechanics_boundary: Grab-and-slam sequence with five ground slams and hard knockdown on the final slam; source reports 15% total damage. Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan)'s use includes Super Armor, which is not generalized to Kale or Broly (DB Super).

records.name: Energy Release
records.mechanics_boundary: Towa-exclusive stationary Ki-charge stance. Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes it as slower than Energy Charge; Towa is the documented user and the skill is not separately obtainable by CaCs. Exact charge rate, frame timing, and total refill timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Super Destructo-Disc
records.mechanics_boundary: Chargeable large Destructo-Disc that tracks and is unblockable; current evidence distinguishes it from the normal Destructo-Disc by faster travel, no restand, and combo potential after sufficiently long knockback. Tracking can be engaged after firing while unlocked and then locking on.

records.name: Android Rush
records.mechanics_boundary: Four-hit rush: three kicks followed by a final backhand/punch/kick that launches the opponent. Directional input changes the final knockback route: neutral forward, up downward, down upward. Current evidence reports about 10% total damage.

records.name: Burning Attack
records.mechanics_boundary: Long hand-seal startup followed by a large projectile that explodes on impact, launches the opponent upward, and can briefly stun/trip them. Current skill-specific evidence reports about 15% damage.

records.name: Chaos Shot
records.mechanics_boundary: Uncharged version fires Ki Blasts in multiple directions for two hits; holding the input concentrates the attack forward for nine hits. Current source-reported damage is about 10% uncharged and 15% charged; the move is associated with Frost.

records.name: Surging Spirit
records.mechanics_boundary: Built-in Ultra Instinct Ki-charge action rather than a separately acquired equipable skill. Goku (Ultra Instinct) and Goku (Ultra Instinct -Sign-) use it; CaCs can access it while Ultra Instinct is active through the dedicated guard+heavy input. Current evidence describes roughly five seconds to refill Ki and identifies it as slightly faster than Maximum Charge.

records.name: Reverse Shot
records.mechanics_boundary: Four Ki bullets fire initially; if a blast has not hit after roughly one second it reverses and tracks from behind. At red health the move instead fires eight blasts. Current references report about 5% total damage normally and 15% at red health.

records.name: Grand Smasher
records.mechanics_boundary: Large Ki ball Ultimate; current evidence reports 21 hits and about 35% damage. While the projectile is touching the opponent, an additional input spends 100 more Ki and detonates it for five extra unblockable hits, establishing a documented 300–400 Ki resource range.

validation.identity_scope: All frontier records already exist in the canonical corpus; evidence artifacts do not create duplicate identities.
validation.pq_boundary: Acquisition endpoints are not converted into PQ reward edges unless explicit reward evidence exists.
validation.mechanics_reconciliation: Batch 03 and Batch 04 are appended as evidence-only boundaries; canonical skills.json remains authoritative.

next_frontier: Continue the mechanics evidence census on the next unaudited canonical skills cohort, prioritizing records with explicit current behavior evidence.
Where a dedicated current-evidence audit already exists, reconcile it into canonical fields only when the field-level evidence is safe to promote.
Continue explicit PQ typed-reward parity separately from skill acquisition endpoints.
